review_rules: Removal options mean proposed changes only; historical exact baseline is immutable.
Do not alter any stable IDs, SRS/FSRS state, locked materials, runtime UI, or another project's dataset.
On approval, create a new curated successor and changed-ID delta ledger, preserve provenance, recheck dependencies and perform scoped QA.
Relocating a card within A1 requires separate lesson-membership checks; never auto-inject into A2/B1.
Review 1 lesson per user approval round; never silently continue to L02 before owner response.
